summary.text: Sarah Reggi is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked as a speech-language pathologist in West Virginia public schools for 23 years and is currently with Ohio County Schools.

paragraphs.text: Reggi grew up in Marshall County, where she said she took part in 4-H and a church youth group.
She earned a high school diploma from John Marshall High School, a bachelor's degree from West Liberty State College in 2000, and a graduate degree from West Virginia University in 2002.
She said she is a member of Education West Virginia, serves as a school building union representative, and has joined the AFL-CIO.
She lives in Moundsville with her husband.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Reggi named public schools as a key priority, saying the state should update school funding formulas and act on the RAND report.
She also listed affordability, including utility bills and childcare costs, as a priority.
